newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Plane crashes in Costa Rica with six aboard.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Costa Rica with six aboard.

text.p: A small plane with six people aboard crashed in San Jose on Friday and authorities could not immediately say whether there were survivors.
The plane was en route from the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica to the capital, San Jose, when the accident occurred at 8:45 a.m. (1405 GMT), Red Cross spokesman Luis Barahona told Reuters.

He said the single-engine plane owned by tourist company Travelair had taken off 30 minutes earlier from Tortuguero, a popular tourist destination in the northeastern corner of the Central American country.
"Rescue teams from different agencies have gone to the accident zone about 15 kilometres (nine miles) northeast of central San Jose, but they haven't made contact with the airplane," Barahona said.
A worker at Travelair told Reuters the company had no information about the crash.
